requirement:
The coverage overview counts documented source items carrying coverage
annotations, once per source item, and groups them by source file. Directory
summaries include these items in all descendants,
regardless of which groups are expanded. Read or parse failures that prevent
discovering annotations are visible and are not presented as a complete
absence of documentation.
rationale: The three marked tests in `src/execution_coverage/book.rs` cover each obligation in `requirements.test-coverage.index.gaps.summary`. I did not read the implementation or the `fixture`, `directory_group` and `file_card` helpers. I relied on the test text and its assertions. **Count once per source item.** - `documented_items_are_counted_once_with_browsable_directory_and_file_groups` builds `code.rs` with a root annotation and two `cite` blocks on `fn one`. It builds `src/direct.rs` with two annotated functions, and also adds `src/deep/nested.rs`, `vendor/foreign.rs` and `docs_only/deep/item.rs`. - It asserts the overall text "7 documented source items carrying coverage annotations". That is 2+2+1+1+1, so the double-annotated `fn one` counts once. - Per-file counts are asserted: 2 for `code.rs` and `src/direct.rs`, 1 for `src/deep/nested.rs`. - Each file card must list the expected `{file}:{line} #{selector}` locations, such as `File root` and `fn[one]`. - An unannotated file, `src/pass.rs`, must be absent. **Group by source file.** - The same test asserts that each annotated file has its own `data-file` row and card. - It asserts that exactly 5 `File notes:` chapters exist. - It checks directory contents through `assert_directory_contents`. **Directory summaries include all descendants.** - The same test checks each directory summary count: `src` 3, `src/deep` 1, `vendor` 1, `docs_only` 1 and `docs_only/deep` 1. - `src` has 3 although it holds only `direct.rs` (2 items) directly. The other item comes from the nested `src/deep` directory. - `docs_only` has no direct files, yet its summary counts 1 from `docs_only/deep`, and the assertion that `docs_only` holds no `data-file=` rows outside its child directory confirms the count is not from direct files. - Directory groups are `open` and file cards are `aria-expanded="false"` and `hidden`. Counts are asserted in the summary in both states, so they do not depend on expansion. **Read or parse failures are visible and not shown as absence.** - `empty_documentation_and_source_failures_are_distinct` first checks that a repository with no annotations shows "No documented coverage gaps are present." - It then adds an unparsable `broken.rs`. The overview must contain "Source notes unavailable" and `broken.rs`, must not contain the empty message, and a `File notes: broken.rs` chapter must exist. - It also corrupts the git index. The overview must then contain "cannot discover reference sources" and must not contain the empty message. - `missing_and_unreadable_sources_produce_overview_diagnostics` (unix only) covers a source with mode 0o000, which must show the diagnostic and not the empty message. It also covers a missing indexed source ("code.rs: current source is missing"). - That test also checks that missing excluded or disallowed files produce no diagnostic and still give the empty message. This is consistent with the requirement, since they reveal no annotations. The assertions enforce the expected outcomes. I found no unaddressed clause and no relevant unmarked test, and no `{fixme}` acknowledgments apply.
